Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This is the 3rd Weber grill I've purchased, though this is the first for my personal use.
The price tag always kicks me in the teeth but it's always worth it.
So far we've done pretty much every meat on it, whether it was fully cooked on the grill or sous-vide first and then seared.
Everything has turned out great -- the new ignition is incredible plus it this grill just cooks things properly.  You can't bet on that with other brands.
I'm very satisfied with this grill.  The only way I would change my mind is if it didn't last -- but I don't expect that!
The grill we just gave away was bought in 1997 and it was still working, just needed some attention and it took up a lot more space.
Looking forward to grilling on this for a LONG time!
Results.Title: Looking forward to grilling for a LONG time!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I love this grill.  It is the perfect size for me.  I contemplated the three vs two burner and decided to go w/ the 2 burner primarily due to price but it was a great decision.  I rarely grill for more than 2 people but I did have a small get together and was able to fit a lot on this grill.  I love that it has a gas gauge so I can see if my gas is getting low and that the tank sits nicely on the side easy to turn on and off.  Would definitely recommend this little grill to those that arent throwing huge bbqs all the time and just want a sturdy, well built and designed grill for everyday grilling needs.
Results.Title: Perfect for Everyday Grilling

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
